questions.q: In A = [[0, 6, 3], [−6, −3, 4], [2, −2, 0]], the value of a₁₃a₂₃ + a₃₁ is —
If A is a square matrix with A² = A, then (I + A)² − 3A equals —
questions.work: (I + A)² = I + 2A + A² = I + 3A (since A² = A). So (I + A)² − 3A = I.

questions.q: A and B are 2 × 2 matrices with aᵢⱼ = i + j and bᵢⱼ = i − j. Find (i) A + 2B, (ii) AB, (iii) A', (iv) B⁻¹.

True or False: (a) Two matrices are comparable if they have the same number of rows and columns. (b) If A is skew-symmetric, all its diagonal elements are zero. (c) (AB)' = A'B'. (d) If A = [[2, −1, 5], [3, 8, 7]], then A' = [[2, 3], [−1, 8], [5, 7]].
questions.answer:
(a) True.
(b) True — aᵢᵢ = −aᵢᵢ ⇒ aᵢᵢ = 0.
(c) False — (AB)' = B'A'.
(d) True — rows become columns.

questions.q: For any 3 × 3 matrix A, prove that (A')' = A.
questions.answer:
Let A = [aᵢⱼ]. Then A' = [bᵢⱼ] with bᵢⱼ = aⱼᵢ, and (A')' = [cᵢⱼ] with cᵢⱼ = bⱼᵢ = aᵢⱼ.
So (A')' and A have the same order and equal elements: (A')' = A.

questions.q: For what values of x and y are [[2x + 1, 3y], [0, y² − 5y]] and [[x + 3, y² + 2], [0, −6]] equal?
questions.answer:
2x + 1 = x + 3 ⇒ x = 2.
3y = y² + 2 ⇒ y² − 3y + 2 = 0 ⇒ y = 1 or 2.
y² − 5y = −6 ⇒ y² − 5y + 6 = 0 ⇒ y = 2 or 3.
Common value: y = 2. So x = 2, y = 2.
